description: Check status, set, or verify domains for a website. status returns the current subdomain/custom domain and DNS instructions. set updates the subdomain (mystore.socialai.one) and/or a custom domain — after setting a custom domain, point its DNS to Social AI as shown. verify checks the custom domain CNAME and saves its verification state (requires write access and an active package slot).

domain.description: verify: the custom domain to verify, e.g. www.example.com

name: manage_domain
